import html # Predefined HTML template for a blog post. # {title} and {body} are placeholders that will be safely escaped before insertion. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def create_blog_post(heading: str, text: str) -> str: """ Prepare a blog post for safe web display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. text : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and HTML‑formatted blog post, ready for secure presentation on a webpage. Raises ------ TypeError If either `heading` or `text` is not a string. """ if not isinstance(heading, str): raise TypeError("heading must be a string") if not isinstance(text, str): raise TypeError("text must be a string") # Escape special HTML characters to prevent injection attacks (CWE-74). safe_title = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Construct the final HTML output using the template. return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
